textures.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: production PBR diffuse/albedo texture for a lightly weathered teak outdoor resort bench. Generate one portrait image, 1024 by 3072 if possible, filled edge to edge with a continuous close-up scan of natural sanded teak wood FACE grain, representing a 25 cm wide by 90 cm tall surface. Grain runs vertically from top to bottom. Authentic irregular fine vessels, restrained wandering cathedral grain, sparse very small knot features, occasional fine longitudinal hairline checks and subtle grey-brown sun bleaching. Muted honey taupe brown teak, gently varied between golden and silvery-brown areas, not orange. Rich photographic microdetail without strong dark artificial stripes. Completely flat orthographic top-down, cross-polarised evenly lit de-lit albedo: NO directional lighting, NO reflections, NO shadows, NO vignette. No separate planks, no board gaps, no plank ends, no borders, no objects, no text or lettering, no watermark. This will be mapped onto individual narrow rounded 3D slats with separate end-grain geometry; output only the useful flat wood texture, not a scene or a picture of a bench.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a production PBR diffuse/albedo texture for a cast concrete outdoor resort bench support. A square 2048 by 2048 image filled edge to edge with one continuous flat close-up scanned architectural fair-faced concrete surface representing about 45 cm by 45 cm. Warm pale mineral grey, fine sand and tiny limestone aggregate speckles, sparse small irregular air pinholes, very subtle dry weathering and restrained cement mottling. The material is maintained and lightly aged, not damaged or dirty industrial concrete. Photographic crisp microdetail at real scale, neutral cross-polarised de-lit diffuse scan, completely flat orthographic top-down, uniformly illuminated. No directional shadows, reflections, bright highlights, cloudy large stains, vignette, board seams, slabs, borders, visible edges, cracks, objects, text or watermarks. Only the usable flat concrete texture; this will be mapped onto already bevelled 3D bench supports.
